document.title: Working instructions
document.shortPractice: Keep notes and tasks together by topic. Use one task list per topic rather than copying tasks into separate notes. Keep existing names and links intact, and ask before changing the filing structure or moving content.
document.purpose: Follow these instructions when helping the workspace owner organize notes and tasks in this workspace.
document.contextHelp: The following is the owner's description, not a list of additional inferred preferences.
document.scope: Use these instructions within the user’s current request, including the requested onboarding import. They do not independently authorize external actions or tool development. If a request conflicts with these instructions, clarify whether the working method should change.
